reference_basis.instruction: Treat relational geometry as the identity anchor. Do not copy pose, expression, clothing, accessories, camera distortion, or environment.

face_geometry.description: Soft heart-to-oval face, widest through the upper cheeks, narrowing through a gently tapered jaw into a small rounded chin. Compact midface; soft cheek volume rather than sharp sculpting.

eyes.description: Large dark-brown rounded-almond eyes, set slightly wider than one eye width, with visible upper-lid folds, softly lifted outer corners, and an open expressive gaze.

brows.description: Dark full brows, low-to-medium set, mostly straight through the inner half with a soft outer arch and natural texture.

nose.description: Relatively narrow straight bridge, compact softly rounded tip, and subtle nostril width; delicate relative to cheek width.

mouth.description: Broad mouth with naturally full lips, defined cupid's bow, and a fuller lower lip. Retain width and volume without filler-like exaggeration.

skin.description: Warm light-to-olive skin with dense natural freckles across the nose and upper cheeks, scattered more lightly across forehead, lower cheeks, neck, and upper body; realistic pores and tonal variation.

hair.description: Long thick dark espresso-brown hair with subtle natural wave, warm brown highlights in strong light, irregular face-framing strands, and a natural slightly imperfect hairline. Styling may change.

body_proportions.description: Petite-to-average height, naturally curvy and softly toned; compact torso, defined waist, fuller bust, hips and thighs, with soft feminine limb proportions.

identity_relationships.facial_length_to_width: moderately short face; cheek width dominates facial length
identity_relationships.eye_spacing: slightly wide-set; inner-eye gap a little greater than one eye width
identity_relationships.cheek_to_jaw_transition: full upper cheeks flow smoothly into a gently tapered lower face
identity_relationships.nose_to_mouth_relationship: compact narrow nose above a noticeably broader mouth
identity_relationships.lip_ratio: full upper lip with defined bow; lower lip slightly fuller
identity_relationships.feature_balance: large eyes and broad mouth carry expression while nose and chin remain compact

expression_behavior.neutral: Relaxed playful resting expression with soft mouth corners and alert eyes.
expression_behavior.smile: Broadens laterally, lifts and rounds the cheeks, and deepens subtle smile creases without changing the narrow chin.
expression_behavior.cheek_response: Cheeks rise prominently toward the lower eyelids and appear fuller.
expression_behavior.eye_response: Eyes narrow softly during a full smile or wink but retain their rounded-almond shape.

signature_features.feature: dense freckle field across nose and upper cheeks
broad full mouth paired with a compact nose
heart-to-oval face tapering to a small rounded chin

negative_identity_constraints: do not converge toward Luna's rounder short-face geometry
